ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This class will be held on Tuesdays from 6-8 PM and Wednesdays from 10-11:30 AM. Undergraduate students should register for 3 credit hours; graduate students should register for 4 credit hours. This class will be held in the Carriage House Conference Room at The Phillips Collection. There will be no class during Spring Break.
